name: Q. What types of events do you cover for photography?

acceptedAnswer.text: We provide professional photography services for birthdays, anniversaries, baby showers, baby welcome, pre-wedding shoots, weddings, corporate events, and more.

name: Q. How many photos will I receive from an event shoot?

acceptedAnswer.text: We usually click around 150-200 high-quality photos per event. All photos are soft copies, color-corrected, and shared with you within 24 hours.

name: Q. Do you offer candid photography?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Our packages include candid photography, where our photographers capture natural, unposed moments of your celebration.

name: Q. Are edited photos included in the package?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, every package includes color correction for all photos. In some premium packages, you also get 20 edited photos of your choice. Extra edits are available at ₹70/photo.

name: Q. How soon will I receive the photos after the event?

acceptedAnswer.text: You will receive a web gallery link within 24 hours of the event. This link is permanent and much easier to use than traditional drive links.

name: Q. Do I need to pay full in advance?

acceptedAnswer.text: We usually take a small advance for confirmation, and the balance is collected after the shoot. Payment details will be shared while booking.

name: Q. Can I choose the photographer for my event?

acceptedAnswer.text: We assign professional photographers based on availability, location, and event type to ensure quality. However, all our photographers are vetted, experienced, and trained.

name: Q. How can I book a photography service with HORA

acceptedAnswer.text: You can book directly via our website or by chatting with us. Share your event details, and we’ll match you with the best photography package.

name: Q. Is there any extra cost for additional hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if your event goes beyond the 4-hour window, we charge ₹650 per extra hour.

name: Q. Can I customize my photography package?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely! Our team can help you customize the package to match your event duration, theme, and preferences.

name: Q. Do you provide both traditional and candid photography?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we offer both traditional posed photography and candid photography, depending on the package you choose.

name: Q. What if I need photography urgently?

acceptedAnswer.text: We do take last-minute bookings based on availability. Please contact us directly for urgent requirements.

name: Q. What is the quality of your photos and equipment?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use DSLRs and mirrorless cameras like Canon 80D, Sony A7M3, Canon R6, and more – all handled by expert photographers.

name: Q. Can I view some sample work before booking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we can share previous event galleries and sample portfolios on request so you can see our work quality.

name: Q. Why should I book photography with HORA instead of hiring someone locally?

acceptedAnswer.text: With HORA, you get verified photographers, best pricing, fast delivery, free consultation, and a smooth, professional experience—no risks, no last-minute surprises.
